hypothesis.statement: In a 24/7 market, activity, liquidity, settlement and fiat-market overlap make returns uneven across UTC clock hours: 01:00-05:00 UTC is weak (negative drift), 15:00-16:00 UTC is strong, and the last three hours of the UTC day are positive. Holding a fixed +1 unit of the registered instruments during the strong windows and -1 unit during the weak window is expected to be net positive after fees, funding and the registered adverse slippage.
hypothesis.mechanism: Clock-time seasonality is not a price signal: it is the recurring daily shape of flow. The source attributes it to the overlap of the Asian night, the European open and the US session, plus the funding/settlement cycle of perpetual markets.
hypothesis.direction: BOTH sides are registered and evaluated: a LONG leg (15:00-16:00 UTC), a SHORT leg (01:00-05:00 UTC) and a secondary LONG leg (21:00-24:00 UTC). The source does not specify a short, so the short leg is registered as its own candidate and its result is reported on its own - the long and short legs are never merged into a single number without separate reporting, and every cohort is judged independently (contract 7.3).
hypothesis.test_statistic: Every one of the 4 cohorts (BTCUSDT/1h, ETHUSDT/1h, BNBUSDT/1h, SOLUSDT/1h): the deterministic historical-only winner cell is carried unchanged into OOS, the full window, twelve registered phase grids and its historical parameter neighbourhood. The family statistic is the COUNT of cohort survivors (0..4), never a cross-cohort median and never the best cohort.
hypothesis.source: Reviewed wiki record quant/crypto-intraday-utc-return-seasonality-tea-time-2026-09-03.md (already-reviewed research pool; a 38-venue CEX pair study, treated as research-only and NOT as perpetual-futures evidence).
hypothesis.panel_test: The panel is run with equal notional across the four eligible instruments, and the equal-notional panel equity is reported as a descriptive (non_gating) diagnostic: each cohort starts from the same registered starting equity, so the equal-weighted mean of the four daily equity curves IS the equal-notional panel. No cohort can be hidden by a panel average - the cohort dispositions are the only gate.

signal_domain.signal_input: clock time only - no price history, no trend or mean-reversion estimate, no funding input on the signal side
signal_domain.entry_timing: entry fills at the OPEN of the bar that starts at the window's UTC boundary, adversarially slipped by the registered baseline ticks
signal_domain.exit_timing: the window end is a HARD boundary: after the last bar of the window the position is reduce-only flattened at that bar's close (the engine never carries a layer into the next window)
signal_domain.flat_rule: all hours outside the registered windows of the active case are FLAT
signal_domain.overlap_rule: the registered windows never overlap (04:59 < 15:00 < 16:00 < 21:00 and 24:00 < 01:00), so the legs of a combined case never hold a position at the same time; the engine still fails closed on any overlap and counts it
signal_domain.no_extra_exits: no signal-level stop-loss, take profit or trailing stop is added (the source specifies none): the only exits are the registered DCA rail's breakeven-anchored TP, its resting invalidation, the window-end flatten and the inherited capital-exhaustion backstop

stress_variants.entry_delay_1_bar: the WHOLE episode is shifted one bar later (entry at the next bar's open, exit at the close of the same registered number of bars). Delaying only the entry inside a fixed window would delete every 1-bar leg (the 15:00-16:00 long window), which is a structural artifact rather than an execution stress.
stress_variants.boundary_alt: the registered boundary-alternative robustness track: the whole schedule is mapped ONE BAR EARLIER - the schedule a reader would get if the raw bar labels had been END-time labels instead of the verified open-time labels. It re-runs the full registered product on the OOS slice and on the full window and is a family-level falsification reader (timezone fragility).

parameter_domain.kind: strategy parameter domain (the registered clock-window case set), one composite axis over the three leg switches
parameter_domain.case_definition: a strategy case is a non-empty subset of the three registered legs ({long, short, secondary_long}); the registered domain is ALL seven non-empty subsets, in the registered order below
parameter_domain.legs_status: SOURCE_NORMALIZED - the three clock windows are the source record's own seasonality cells (01:00-05:00 UTC weak, 15:00-16:00 UTC strong, the last three hours of the UTC day positive), normalised to this venue's 1h bar grid. The source studies 38 CEX pair markets, not perpetual futures; the normalisation is registered here and is never re-tuned after seeing results.
parameter_domain.entry_timing_status: RESEARCH_PROPOSED - the source estimates hourly seasonality only and does not specify an entry/exit convention. This round registers: entry fills at the OPEN of the bar that starts at the window's UTC boundary (the boundary is known ex ante, so the boundary price is executable and no look-ahead is introduced), and the window end is a HARD reduce-only flatten at the close of the bar that ends at the window's closing boundary. Every phase grid uses the same convention; the boundary-alternative track is the registered exception.
parameter_domain.secondary_leg_combination_rule: REGISTERED BEFORE THE FIRST RUN (no post-hoc combination). (1) Both tracks - with and without the secondary 21:00-24:00 leg - are registered as strategy cases of this domain; nothing is decided after seeing results. (2) Whether the secondary leg is part of a cohort's winner is decided ONLY by the deterministic HISTORICAL-only selector of contract 7.3 over this registered domain; the OOS window is never used to decide inclusion. (3) The incremental value of the secondary leg is reported per cohort as a NON-GATING diagnostic computed on the registered pair (the elected case against the same case with the secondary leg toggled off, on both the OOS and the full slice). A diagnostic can never promote or demote a cohort.
parameter_domain.domain_immutability: The domain is complete and bounded; no post-hoc parameter additions, no selection on OOS (contract 7.3).

dca_execution_semantics.authorization: Inherited verbatim from the Strategy A/B/C engine family (the ladder geometry, breakeven-anchored TP and resting invalidation semantics); this round parametrises the four axes, mirrors the rail sym-directionally for the short leg and bounds it by the registered clock windows - it does not re-interpret the execution semantics.
dca_execution_semantics.trigger_anchoring: the LADDER is anchored on the INITIAL ENTRY FILL PRICE of the episode
dca_execution_semantics.invalidation_anchoring: the resting invalidation is anchored on the running AVERAGE COST, the same reference as the breakeven-anchored TP
dca_execution_semantics.window_bounded: tranche #1 is the initial entry at the window's first bar open; adverse-price scale-ins follow the ladder inside the window (long: level_k price = initial_entry_price x (1 - spacing_pct x k); short: level_k price = initial_entry_price x (1 + spacing_pct x k), k = 1..10, so at most 11 routine active levels of the 12-tranche rail); the window-end flatten reduce-only closes every layer, then the book is FLAT and no layer may be added again before the next registered window

engine_semantics.entry: the OPEN of the bar that starts at the window boundary, taker fill with adverse slippage
engine_semantics.sizing: non-compounding fixed-quote basis on the pre-registered starting equity: level k margin = base_quote x size_multiplier^k (k = 0..10); level notional = margin x leverage
engine_semantics.take_profit: reduce-only full flatten of the whole episode when the bar reaches running_average_cost x (1 + breakeven_tp_pct) for a long (bar HIGH) / x (1 - breakeven_tp_pct) for a short (bar LOW)
engine_semantics.invalidation: a RESTING stop at running_average_cost x (1 - invalidation_pct) for a long and x (1 + invalidation_pct) for a short, anchored on the same reference as the take profit
engine_semantics.intrabar_ordering: Long episodes: descending-price trigger walk with the bar LOW reached first, then the HIGH; walking down from the bar open, the next trigger is whichever of the next ladder level and the resting stop is HIGHER, and the stop fills at min(stop price, bar open) so a gap through the stop cannot fill at the stop price. Short episodes mirror this exactly (HIGH first, then LOW; the next trigger is whichever of the next ladder level and the resting stop is LOWER; the stop fills at max(stop price, bar open)). Deterministic and never flattering.
engine_semantics.capital_exhaustion: backstop only: forced full flatten at the bar close if unrealised equity <= margin_maint x notional; evaluated after the trigger walk and after the resting stop
engine_semantics.concurrency: one position episode at a time; the registered windows never overlap; no pyramiding beyond the ladder; no add after a FLAT/kill; long and short legs are never held simultaneously

selector_and_disposition.selection_protocol: Deterministic, historical window ONLY; OOS must never be used to select parameters.
selection_steps: 1. Sufficiency: if the cohort's best historical case has fewer episodes than gates.min_episodes_is (200 registered hold windows), the cohort is culled with reason insufficient_trades.
2. Eligibility: a case is a candidate iff historical net_pnl > 0 AND historical sharpe > 0 AND historical episodes >= gates.min_episodes_is.
3. If no case is a candidate, the cohort is culled with reason no_qualifying_candidate.

4. Ranking: Sharpe descending, then net_pnl descending, then a fixed lexical tie-break over the REGISTERED INDEX of each axis in the fixed order (window_case, spacing_pct, size_multiplier, breakeven_tp_pct, invalidation_pct). The first case is the cohort winner.
5. The winner's strategy params + DCA params are carried as ONE frozen bundle into OOS / full / robustness / neighbourhood; the bundle is never re-chosen after OOS is seen.
cohort_survivor_requirements: b) OOS: net_pnl > 0 AND sharpe > 0 for the winner's cell
c) full window: net_pnl > 0 for the winner's cell
d) robustness: the SAME winner cell has net_pnl > 0 in each of fee_2x, funding_2x, entry_delay_1_bar, slippage_2ticks

e) parameter-neighbourhood stability: at least 60% of the winner cell's legal face-adjacent neighbours (+-1 registered step on exactly ONE axis of the joint space) agree with the winner's HISTORICAL net-PnL sign; historical rows only

family_disposition.>=1 cohort survivors: PASS (band MULTIPLE_SURVIVORS above one); every survivor is frozen by contract 10.8 and advances, and the survivor count is never itself a reason for performance_claimable=false
family_disposition.coverage or technical incompleteness: TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE (no cohort is judged at all)

selector_and_disposition.cross_cohort_medians: never a gate (contract 7.2): any cross-cohort or all-case median reported in the artifacts is descriptive and marked non_gating, and the equal-notional panel diagnostic is likewise non_gating

registered_family_level_falsification.note: The card's falsification battery lands in the current cohort-survivor semantics as follows (no threshold is lowered and no item is deleted). The two items below are FAMILY-level: they never cull a cohort by themselves and they can never be recorded as PASS.

timezone-fragility.definition: the elected winner's OOS net-PnL sign under the registered boundary-alternative track (the whole schedule mapped one bar earlier, i.e. the end-time-labelling reading) differs from the sign under the primary open-time mapping
timezone-fragility.landing: family-level: a hit must NEVER be recorded as PASS; the evidence decides REJECT vs DEFERRED (the runner recommends DEFERRED when the cohorts would otherwise have passed)

window-instability.definition: for an elected winner's DCA config on the full window: the long_only case's net PnL summed over 2024, 2025 and the partial 2026 is <= 0 AND the short_only case's net PnL over the same years is <= 0 - i.e. the 15:00-16:00 long window stops contributing after 2024 and the 01:00-05:00 short window contributes nothing positive either. The 2022-2023 aggregate of the same legs is reported alongside (the registered sub-period stability track).
window-instability.landing: family-level: a hit must NEVER be recorded as PASS; the evidence decides REJECT vs DEFERRED (the runner recommends DEFERRED when the cohorts would otherwise have passed)

data.split_immutability: The split is fixed here, before any computation, and must not be moved afterwards.
data.derived_store: Built per attempt from raw into the rebuildable /qlib/work area via upstream qlib dump_bin.py; read back exclusively through the qlib data layer. Never written to /results. Bars are never resampled or gap-filled: a missing bar stays missing, and a non-contiguous 1h grid fails the run closed.

bar_labelling.finding: open_time_ms is the bar START in UTC: close_time_ms = open_time_ms + 3,599,999 ms on a contiguous 3,600,000 ms grid, and the first bar of every registered symbol opens exactly at 2022-01-01T00:00:00Z
bar_labelling.consequence: the registered window schedule maps to the bar that OPENS at the measured boundary; the boundary-alternative robustness track re-maps the whole schedule one bar earlier (the end-time-labelling reading)

funding_series_contract.registered_window: 2022-01-01T00:00:00Z .. 2026-09-11T23:59:59Z (the registered data window; the raw file now extends past it and is not used beyond data_end)

measured_at_pre_registration.extra_schedule_disclosure: SOLUSDT additionally carries 2h/4h-era settlements in early 2022 (02:00/04:00/06:00/10:00/12:00/14:00/18:00/20:00/22:00 UTC), so the engine never assumes a fixed 8h grid: every settlement is charged on its own instant
measured_at_pre_registration.jitter_ms: 0..28 ms LATE relative to the nominal boundary, never early (all four symbols)
measured_at_pre_registration.modelled_segment: 2022-01-01 .. 2023-10-31 is a `modeled_funding` reconstruction (2005 observations per symbol); the official segment is mark-price based

funding_series_contract.primary_use: the registered series is used as a COST only (the signal is clock time); every settlement whose instant lies in the window's closed exposure interval is charged, and the modelled/official split is disclosed in the artifacts
funding_series_contract.no_fabrication: the artifacts must disclose the modelled/official split; no modelled row may be relabelled official

costs.source: canonical instrument metadata (raw binance/usdm/instruments/usdm-perp-instruments.json), read at run time, never hard-coded
costs.apply_rule: every fill is a market order: taker fee on the full traded notional, plus adverse slippage of baseline_slippage_ticks instrument ticks (1 tick = price_increment). No maker fills are assumed anywhere.
costs.baseline_slippage_provenance: research assumption of this round (NOT user-specified); robustness re-measures it at 2 ticks
costs.funding: the registered funding series is charged at each settlement inside the window's exposure interval (rate x position notional, inherited convention); a negative rate is a CREDIT to a long position and a COST to a short position. The no_funding / no_funding_full grids re-measure the same cells with the funding cost zeroed (descriptive), and funding_2x doubles it.
costs.funding_exposure_rule: The position is exposed to every funding settlement whose raw instant lies in the CLOSED interval [entry instant - 1s, exit instant + 1s]. The measured raw jitter of the settlement timestamps is 0..28 ms LATE and never early (all four symbols), so a settlement sitting on a window boundary is charged to the window that holds the position at that instant: the long 15:00-16:00 window pays the 16:00 settlement, the secondary 21:00-24:00 window pays the 00:00 settlement, and the short 01:00-05:00 window pays any settlement inside it (the 0/8/16h grid carries none, but SOLUSDT's early-2022 2h/4h schedule does). A settlement is charged on the position notional at the moment of the charge: the close of the bar that contains it inside the window, or the episode's exit fill price when it lands at the closing boundary. The sign follows the position: a positive rate is a cost to a long and a credit to a short. Settlements outside the closed interval are never charged.
costs.cost_attrition_grid: cost_attrition_40bps applies 8x the registered taker fee = 40 bps per fill, the registered attrition stress of the original falsification battery (G8)
costs.funding_immutability: the funding baseline must not be swapped for a modelled series to improve the outcome, nor vice versa

authorization_invariants.provenance_class: USER_FIXED - only items with explicit operator evidence (the operator's stated rail definition, inherited verbatim from the A/B/C registration). A searched axis, a project pre-registration constant or a signal-mechanics field must NOT be listed here.
authorization_invariants.side: long AND short: a long leg (15:00-16:00 UTC, +1 unit), a short leg (01:00-05:00 UTC, -1 unit) and a secondary long leg (21:00-24:00 UTC, +1 unit). The short leg mirrors the long rail sym-directionally.
authorization_invariants.long_short_coexistence: never: the registered clock windows are disjoint, the long and short legs are never held at the same time, and any overlap fails the run closed

metrics_definitions.equity: 30000 + cumulative realised net PnL (USDT); unrealised marked at bar closes
metrics_definitions.daily_series: end-of-UTC-day equity marks of the EVALUATED slice, forward-filled inside the slice only; the series is never padded with the pre-window history
metrics_definitions.sharpe: mean/std (ddof=1) of the slice's daily returns x sqrt(365); risk-free 0. The slice scoping is registered explicitly because a cohort-wide series padded with the pre-window days would deflate the mean and the standard deviation unevenly and silently shrink Sharpe by sqrt(slice/cohort) - a measurement defect, not a convention. OOS Sharpe is a gate (G4), so the definition is part of the pre-registration.
metrics_definitions.max_dd: peak-to-trough of the daily equity series, reported in % and USDT
metrics_definitions.cagr: (ending_equity / 30000) ^ (1/years) - 1, years from the actual bar span of the slice
metrics_definitions.max_effective_leverage: max of (position notional / unrealised equity), sampled every in-market bar
metrics_definitions.capital_utilization: mean of (deployed margin / unrealised equity) over in-market bars
metrics_definitions.turnover: sum of |fill notional| over every entry / DCA add / exit fill of the cell
metrics_definitions.dca_layer_histogram: count of fills per ladder level, aggregated over all full-window-registered base cases; direct evidence of how much of the 12-tranche rail is reachable under resting-stop sequencing
metrics_definitions.cohort_winner: the historical-only selector output for that cohort
metrics_definitions.panel_equal_notional: descriptive (non_gating) equal-weighted mean of the four cohorts' daily equity curves; never a gate

items.name: parameter-neighbourhood robustness
items.method: for each cohort winner, compare the winner's historical net-PnL sign against its legal face-adjacent neighbours in the registered joint space (window_case, spacing_pct, size_multiplier, breakeven_tp_pct, invalidation_pct); require >= 60% sign agreement; historical rows only. The window_case axis is categorical: its +-1 registered step is the registered reading of the contract's single-axis rule, and that is disclosed because a step on that axis can change the leg set.

items.name: execution stress reruns
items.method: full-window evaluation of all registered cells under fee_2x, funding_2x, entry_delay_1_bar, slippage_2ticks; each winner cell must stay net_pnl > 0 in all four

items.name: boundary / timezone sensitivity
items.method: the registered boundary-alternative track re-runs the full product with the whole schedule mapped one bar earlier (the end-time labelling reading) on the OOS slice and the full window; a sign flip in a winner's OOS result is a family-level falsification (never PASS)

items.name: funding baseline diagnostics
items.method: no_funding (historical window) and no_funding_full (full window) grids for all cells; descriptive only, never a gate

items.name: cost attrition (G8)
items.method: cost_attrition_40bps grid for all cells; the winner's cell must stay net_pnl > 0, otherwise the cohort is culled with reason robustness_economic:cost_attrition_40bps

items.name: long-only / long-short / secondary decomposition
items.method: the singleton cases (long_only, short_only, secondary_long_only) exist in every phase grid, so the long leg, the short leg and the secondary leg are each reported on their own; the secondary leg's incremental value is reported as a non-gating pair diagnostic on OOS and full

items.name: sub-period stability
items.method: per-calendar-year net PnL of each winner cell and of the singleton legs on the full window, aggregated into the 2022-2023 and 2024-2026 halves; the 2024+ arm of the two legs is the registered window-instability falsification reader

items.name: cross-instrument consistency and equal-notional panel
items.method: the four cohorts' directions and outcomes are reported side by side and the equal-notional panel equity is reported (with the without-BTCUSDT subset); both are descriptive, never a gate

items.name: slippage stress
items.method: slippage_2ticks re-runs the full product at two adverse ticks per fill

gates.G1_coverage: every one of the 12 registered phase grids must contain exactly 1344 cases (4 cohorts x 7 strategy cases x 48 DCA configs), the measured strategy/DCA cell sets must equal the registered products, and the case evaluation total must equal 16,128; otherwise TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE and no cohort is judged
gates.G2_insufficient_trades: per cohort: fewer than min_episodes_is (200) historical hold windows in the cohort's best case, or fewer than min_episodes_oos (60) hold windows in the elected winner's OOS slice, culls the cohort (insufficient_trades)
gates.G3_cohort_selector: historical net_pnl > 0 AND sharpe > 0 AND episodes >= min_episodes_is, ranked by Sharpe desc, net_pnl desc, registered-index lexical tie-break
gates.G4_cohort_oos: the registered OOS economic gate is STRICTER than the contract minimum: OOS net_pnl > 0 AND sharpe > 0 AND annualized Sharpe >= min_oos_sharpe (0.40) AND annualized return >= min_oos_annualized_return (0.0)
gates.G5_cohort_full: full-window net_pnl > 0 for the winner's cell
gates.G6_cohort_robustness: the winner's cell has net_pnl > 0 in all four execution stress reruns
gates.G7_cohort_neighbourhood: at least 60% of legal face-adjacent neighbours agree in historical net-PnL sign
gates.G8_cohort_cost_attrition: the winner's cell has net_pnl > 0 in the cost_attrition_40bps grid
gates.verdict_rule: TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE if G1 fails; else each cohort passing G3-G8 is a SURVIVOR: 0 survivors -> REJECT, >=1 survivors -> PASS (band SURVIVOR_FOUND / MULTIPLE_SURVIVORS describes the count only). The two registered family-level falsification items then forbid PASS. No post-hoc threshold edits, no tuning to pass.
gates.min_episodes_is_provenance: the card registers a no-signal floor of 200 panel hold windows for the historical selection window and 60 for the OOS slice; both are adopted verbatim, not lowered, and the OOS arm is evaluated after selection
gates.known_gate_set_limitation: The registered gate set contains no benchmark-relative test. Clock-window strategies can show positive PnL purely through the sample's drift, and the panel's legs are not market-neutral. This limitation is declared BEFORE the run and is NOT patched afterwards; a buy-and-hold comparison remains a non-gating diagnostic.

falsification: no signal / insufficient trades (G2: fewer than 200 historical hold windows in the cohort's best case, or fewer than 60 in the winner's OOS slice; culls the cohort)
OOS economic rejection of the winner cell (G4: annualized Sharpe < 0.40 or annualized return < 0)
full-window economic rejection of the winner cell (G5)
robustness economic failure of the winner cell (G6: fee_2x, funding_2x, entry_delay_1_bar, slippage_2ticks)
parameter-neighbourhood fragility of the winner cell (G7: < 60% historical sign agreement)
cost attrition: the winner cell turns negative under 40 bps per fill (G8)
timezone/boundary fragility: the winner's OOS sign flips under the boundary-alternative track -> family-level, never PASS (REJECT or DEFERRED per the evidence)
window instability: the 15:00-16:00 long window fails after 2024 and the 01:00-05:00 short window contributes nothing positive either -> family-level, never PASS (REJECT or DEFERRED per the evidence)
DCA execution incomplete or not true order-fill accounting (see assertions.json; any false assertion = TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE)
coverage incomplete in any registered phase grid (G1)
the boundary-alternative track is a no-op (if the alternative schedule produced identical measurements the robustness track would be vacuous -> TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE)
performance_claimable_rule: true only when the family verdict == PASS (>=1 cohort survivor) and contract 9.6 holds (canonical raw, no look-ahead, explicit OOS, declared costs, full section 7.2 coverage including the DCA parameter domain) and neither registered family-level falsification item has fired. The number of survivors is never itself a reason to claim false.
